privacy.title: Privacy Notice
privacy.s1.title: 1. Who we are
privacy.s1.body: Onyx Elevate ("we", "us", "our") operates onyxperformance.app and the Onyx Elevate app. We are the data controller of the personal data described in this notice. Contact: OnyxPerformanceTeam@hotmail.com.
privacy.s2.title: 2. Personal data we collect
privacy.s2.body:
• Account data: name, email address, password (hashed), country, language.
  • Profile & training data: workout logs, program progress, favourites, reviews, body measurements you enter (weight, body fat, etc.), goals.
  • Support data: messages you send us and their attachments.
  • Usage & device data: pages visited, features used, device type, browser, approximate location (from IP), crash and performance logs.
  • Cookies & similar technologies: see section 8.
  • Payment data: processed by Stripe (web) or Apple (in-app purchases on iOS). We receive purchase confirmations and metadata (product, amount, country, invoice or transaction ID) but never full card numbers.
privacy.s3.title: 3. How we use your data & legal bases
privacy.s3.body:
• Provide the Service (create your account, deliver programs, sync progress), performance of a contract.
  • Customer support, performance of a contract / legitimate interests.
  • Security, fraud prevention & abuse detection, legitimate interests and legal obligation.
  • Product analytics & improvement, legitimate interests (aggregated where possible).
  • Marketing emails (product updates, tips), consent, which you can withdraw at any time.
  • Legal, tax & accounting, legal obligation.
privacy.s4.title: 4. Who we share data with
privacy.s4.intro: We do not sell your personal data. We share it only with:
privacy.s4.body:
• Stripe Payments Europe, Ltd, our payment processor for web purchases. See Stripe's privacy policy at stripe.com/privacy.
  • Apple Inc., for in-app purchases and subscriptions made through the iOS app. Apple is the seller of record for those transactions. See Apple's privacy policy at apple.com/legal/privacy.
  • Infrastructure & hosting providers (cloud database, storage, edge hosting, email delivery, video streaming).
  • Analytics providers used to understand product usage.
  • Professional advisers (accountants, lawyers) where necessary.
  • Authorities when required by law.
privacy.s5.title: 5. International transfers
privacy.s5.body: Some of our providers are located outside your country, including the EEA/UK and the United States. Where personal data leaves the EEA/UK, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses or adequacy decisions.
privacy.s6.title: 6. Payments
privacy.s6.body: Web payments and refunds are processed by Stripe. In-app purchases and subscriptions on iOS are processed by Apple under Apple's Media Services Terms; Apple is the seller of record for those transactions and handles billing, taxes and refund requests directly.
privacy.s7.title: 7. Data retention
privacy.s7.body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete your account, we delete or anonymise your personal data within a reasonable period, except where we must keep it for legal, tax or dispute-resolution purposes (typically up to 7 years for financial records).
privacy.s8.title: 8. Cookies
privacy.s8.body: We use a minimal set of cookies: essential cookies for login/session, analytics cookies (aggregate usage), and, only if you opt in, marketing cookies. You can manage cookies in your browser at any time; disabling non-essential cookies will not break the site.
privacy.s9.title: 9. Your rights
privacy.s9.intro: Depending on where you live (including under the EU/UK GDPR, LGPD in Brazil, and similar laws), you have the right to:
privacy.s9.body:
• Access the personal data we hold about you.
  • Rectify inaccurate data.
  • Erase your data ("right to be forgotten").
  • Restrict or object to processing.
  • Data portability.
  • Withdraw consent at any time (without affecting prior lawful processing).
  • Lodge a complaint with your local supervisory authority.
privacy.s9.outro: To exercise any of these rights, email OnyxPerformanceTeam@hotmail.com. We respond within one month.
privacy.s10.title: 10. Security
privacy.s10.body: We use appropriate technical and organisational measures, encryption in transit (TLS), encryption at rest for sensitive fields, role-based access controls, and audit logging, to protect your data. No system is perfectly secure, but we work continuously to reduce risk.
privacy.s11.title: 11. Children
privacy.s11.body: Onyx Elevate is intended for users aged 16 and older. We do not knowingly collect data from children under 13. If you believe a child has provided us with personal data, contact us and we will delete it.
privacy.s12.title: 12. Changes
privacy.s12.body: We may update this notice. Material changes will be announced in the app or by email. The "Last updated" date at the top reflects the current version.

measurements.title: Body Measurements
measurements.subtitle: Track what matters. Numbers don't lie, mirrors do.
measurements.guide.title: How to Measure Your Body Fat %
measurements.guide.desc: BMI can't tell you how much fat you carry, here are 4 practical ways to find your real number.
measurements.proTipBody: Pick one method and stick with it. Consistency beats accuracy. Weigh and measure at the same time of day, under the same conditions, for the cleanest progress data.
measurements.log.title: Log a new entry
measurements.empty: No entries yet. Log your first measurement above.
measurements.m1.title: 1. Skinfold Calipers
measurements.m1.s3: Pinch the skin firmly and measure in mm.
measurements.m1.s4: Plug numbers into a Jackson-Pollock calculator online.
measurements.m2.title: 2. Smart Scale (BIA)
measurements.m2.s1: Stand on a smart scale barefoot.
measurements.m2.s2: Send a small electrical signal through your body.
measurements.m2.s3: Hydration affects it, measure at the same time daily.
measurements.m2.acc: ±3, 5%, best for tracking change over time
measurements.m3.title: 3. Tape Measure (Navy Method)
measurements.m3.s1: Measure neck, waist (men) or neck, waist, hips (women).
measurements.m3.s2: Use the U.S. Navy body fat formula (free online).
measurements.m3.s3: No equipment needed, just a tape.
measurements.m3.s4: Best for people who lift, handles muscle better than BMI.
measurements.m4.title: 4. DEXA Scan
measurements.m4.s1: Book at a clinic, university, or sports lab.
measurements.m4.s2: Low-dose X-ray maps fat, muscle, and bone.
measurements.m4.s4: Do it once every 3, 6 months to track real change.
bmi.triggerLabel: Not sure of your body fat %? BMI can't measure fat, but it's a free starting point
bmi.triggerDesc: Quick BMI check, height + weight, no body fat needed.
bmi.title: BMI Calculator
bmi.desc: A starting point when you don't know your body fat percentage yet.
bmi.warning: BMI is a rough guide built for beginners and the general population. It does not distinguish muscle from fat, so trained lifters, athletes, and anyone with above-average muscle mass will almost always score "overweight" or "obese" while being lean and healthy. If that's you, track waist, body-fat %, and progress photos instead.
bmi.footnote: BMI is a screening tool, not a diagnosis. Pair it with waist circumference, progress photos, and how your training feels.
bmi.saveToNotes: Save this BMI to my notes
bmi.invalid: Enter a realistic height (80, 260 cm) and weight (20, 400 kg).

guidelines.title: Training and Nutrition Guidelines
guidelines.s1.title: We guide. You decide.
guidelines.s1.body: Onyx Elevate is a platform built to educate, motivate, and guide you toward better training and nutrition. Everything we publish, from workout programs and exercise demos to recipes and articles, is created with care by coaches who actively train and compete. But we are not your doctor, physiotherapist, or dietitian.
guidelines.s2.title: Exercise and injury responsibility
guidelines.s2.body1: All physical training carries a risk of injury. The way you warm up, how you load the bar, the equipment you use, the condition you are in, and how you recover are all factors only you can control. We show you how to perform movements safely, but you are fully responsible for how you apply that information.
guidelines.s2.body2: If an exercise hurts, stop. If you are unsure about form, film yourself or ask a qualified professional. We cannot see you through the screen, and we do not take responsibility for injuries, accidents, or training related issues that may occur while using our content.
guidelines.s3.title: Food, allergies and nutrition
guidelines.s3.body1: Our recipes are designed to be high protein, practical, and tasty, but they are general guidelines, not personalized medical nutrition. We do not know your allergies, intolerances, medical conditions, or cultural dietary restrictions. You are responsible for checking every ingredient to make sure it is safe for you to consume.
guidelines.s3.body2: If you have celiac disease, diabetes, kidney issues, food allergies, or any condition affected by diet, consult a licensed dietitian or doctor before following any recipe or meal plan from Onyx.
guidelines.s4.title: Supplement references
guidelines.s4.body: Any mention of supplements is purely educational. We do not sell supplements, and we do not prescribe them. Dosages, brands, and legality vary by country and individual. Speak to a pharmacist or physician before taking anything new.
guidelines.s5.title: Consult a professional first
guidelines.s5.body: Before starting any new training program, diet, or supplement routine, especially if you are pregnant, nursing, under 18, over 65, recovering from injury or surgery, taking medication, or living with a medical condition, you must consult a qualified physician. Using Onyx Elevate is entirely at your own risk.
guidelines.s6.title: In short
guidelines.s6.body: We build the roadmap. You drive the car. Use your head, listen to your body, and when in doubt, ask a real professional in person.
